summary: Iter81 (SeasonBar extended to all Team Hub tools + season-scoped data). Backend: 24/24 pytest passed, 1 skipped (legacy-no-season sheet cannot be produced via API — invariant is still exercised via season_query's $or clause). Verified GET /api/roster season filtering (member on team A shown only under season A, member on team B only under season B, unassigned always shows), season stamping on POST for payments/paperwork/signups/attendance, season filtering on GET (own-season shows, other-season hides, no filter shows all), detail endpoints return season_ids, and payments summary.member_total is season-scoped (excludes MB when filtered to S1). Frontend: SeasonBar renders on all 6 requested screens (roster, payments, paperwork, signups, attendance, sizes) with testIDs seasonbar-all / seasonbar-{id} / seasonbar-manage; season-chip switching works (Payments screen visually confirmed with TESTSEASON2026 highlighted).
critical_code_review_comments: In routers/team_payments.py, team_paperwork.py, attendance.py, signups.py: creating a sheet reads active_season_id and stamps season_ids=[sid] if set, else []. GET honors season_query which shows items with empty/missing season_ids in every season filter (legacy-safe). Behavior correct.
roster_season_query correctly includes members with no team_ids (unassigned) even when a season_id filter is applied.

Payments summary.member_total is computed from a season-scoped roster_total (via _roster_total(member_ids, sea)) using the sheet's own season_ids in list/get/duplicate/exclude/set_member — consistent.
SMS remind endpoints (payments, paperwork item remind, signups remind, remind-claimed) also use roster_season_query on the sheet's season, so reminders won't spam out-of-season members. Correct.
seed_data_creation: Created (and cleaned up) 2 seasons (IT81_*_S1, IT81_*_S2), 2 teams (IT81_*_TA on S1, IT81_*_TB on S2), and 3 roster members (MA/MB/MU) during the pytest run.
